On Sunday, officials reported that 1,500 migrants were rescued by the Italian navy and coast guard ships in over less than 24 hours. Coast guard ships came to the aid of five boats in the southern Mediterranean on Saturday and saved all the passengers. These resces are made as new figures show that migrant arrivals into the EU via Italy have increased by 43 percent compared to the same period last year. The 1,500 migrants were rescued on Saturday by two coast guard ships and one navy ship in five separate operations.
